-- SORRY 3: Bad Block Descent Strategy (BBDS) core
-- If a bad block exists at height j >= 4, then a bad block exists at some j' in [3, j)

def TopWindow (C : Finset ℕ) (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ r ∈ C, q / 2 < r ∧ r < q

def Block (q j : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  Finset.Icc ((j - 1) * q + 1) (j * q)

noncomputable def Slot (q j r : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Block q j).filter fun t => ¬(q ∣ t) ∧ r ∣ t

noncomputable def BlockCov (C : Finset ℕ) (q j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((Block q j).filter fun t => ¬(q ∣ t) ∧ ∃ r ∈ C, r ∣ t).card

noncomputable def SlotMass (C : Finset ℕ) (q j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ r ∈ C, (Slot q j r).card

def BadBlock (C : Finset ℕ) (q j : ℕ) : Prop :=
  2 * BlockCov C q j < SlotMass C q j

-- The key insight: if 2*BlockCov < SlotMass at height j >= 4,
-- then there exists a minimal bad subfamily whose normalized pattern
-- appears at a strictly smaller height >= 3.
-- Each r > q/2 has at most 2 multiples per block (slot_card_le_two, proved).
-- The collision structure at height j can be "compressed" to a smaller height.

theorem bad_block_descends_ge_three (C : Finset ℕ) (q j : ℕ)
    (hTop : TopWindow C q)
    (hj : 4 ≤ j) (hbad : BadBlock C q j) :
    ∃ j', 3 ≤ j' ∧ j' < j ∧ BadBlock C q j' := by
  sorry
